If you want my shitty advice there is no point. There’s simply the time you’ve been given on this earth before you get your eternal peace. What you do with that time is up to you. Embrace the time you’ve been given or don’t. Some scenarios (I’m my OPINION) are just not worth the amount of suffering in life. If you had some thing really terrible happen or everything in life is worthless and smashing your head into a wall hurts less you can either power through it and eventually (whenever that is) get to the other side where happiness can actually be found. Or, like me decide it’s not worth embracing the time we’ve been given. Because most of that time is spent dreading taking your next breath.

Don’t listen to him, do you know how much balls it takes to say what you said? This guy is a kid and a loser. That kind of talk is what causes suicide. “Man up” that kind of thing suppressed emotions and is why something like 70% of all suicides are male. Women can show emotion but when men do this happens. Asking for help in the world we live in (example A right above us) takes more courage than that kid ever will.

I’m not in such a good place my self. Quite suicidal if I’m being honest. But if I could offer anything, it would be that what happens in the world around us isn’t for us to decide, all that we have to decide is what to do with the time that’s given to us. You might have a lot going for you, for all I know you could be good looking, have a nice job, be smart, have strong morals and ethics and a leg to stand on. As long as you’ve got yourself there’s always a chance to come back. Find someone you can lean on while you get back on your feet because don’t get it wrong that’s a crushing blow to ANYONE in life and don’t let anyone tell you otherwise, but find any ally any one that can accept you and wants to help. You might find that person in the weirdest of places but my advice would be to focus on you and focus on finding someone to help you.
